Hadith.4453 - In a narration from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said
regarding a woman who commits adultery before her husband consummates the marriage: "They shall be separated, and she is not entitled to a dowry because the offense originated from her."
